TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFFLOORAREA PURSUANTTOSECTION98-33 OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THECITY OF NEW YORK 510/12 WEST 25TH STREET LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Mega Communications, 255 Executive Drive #409, Plainview, New York 11803 ("Transferor") to 524 WEST 19TH STREET CORP., a New York corporation having an address at 524 West 19th Street, New York, New York("Transferee"). 10011 WITNESSETH: WHEREAS Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 42 in Block 696 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 510-12 West 25th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A”annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the"Granting Site"); Transferee is the fee owner of certain real property, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 46 in Block 690 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 524 West 19th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit The Granting Site is a "granting site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the "Zoning Resolution") and the Receiving Site is a "receiving site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of ten ($10.00) dollars, lawful money of the United States, and other valuable consideration paid by Transferee, Transferor does hereby grant, distribute and transfer to Transferee and its successors and assigns forever, as their interests may appear, solely for use on the Receiving Site, subject to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, 3957.1 square feet of floor area, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive the consideration paid by Transferee for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purposes. At the request and expense of Transferee, Transferor covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the premises herein granted unto Transferee, the heirs or successors and assigns of T'ransferee, forever. KL3 2532168.4
